inputs.text: So this whole Liberal split is nothing but elite theater to lock down the real issues. Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the party to be open-minded about raising taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors, but the surface claim of some philosophy clash with the opposition leader is just cover to protect the big interests that profit from those breaks. The opposition leader also refused to back Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump or say whether he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. That kind of silence is never random—it’s the elites making sure the narrative stays controlled and no real pressure builds.
